description: This Java class, CashierTransactionDataValidator, provides validation logic for cashier transaction operations within the Fineract organization module. It includes methods for validating transaction amounts, cashier date ranges, and cashier allocation, integrating with database queries and external services.

classes.name: CashierTransactionDataValidator
classes.description: A validator class for cashier transaction data, ensuring proper transaction amounts, cashier scheduling, and allocation within allowed date ranges, integrating with database and external services.

methods.name: validateSettleCashAndCashOutTransactions
methods.description: Validates whether a cashier has sufficient net cash balance to settle a specified transaction amount, or from a command object.

methods.name: validateCashierAllowedDateAndTime
methods.description: Checks if the cashier's scheduled date and time fall within the teller's operational date range and ensures the cashier has not been allocated during overlapping periods.

methods.name: validateOnLoanDisbursal
methods.description: Validates if the user (staff) is authorized and available for disbursal during the current tenant date and time, then checks cashier transaction sufficiency.
